limitations.quote: I’ll update both Gray pointers on the same edges as their accepted transfers
limitations.note: Registering the write Gray pointer fixed the CDC defect, but using next-state values for both pointers changed when `wfull` and `rempty` update compared with the reference, which only registers the existing write Gray value to match the read side.

The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide which transfers to count, so it could verify FIFO ordering and bounds without detecting the cycle-by-cycle flag timing mismatch against the reference.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: A rejected cleanup command forced the entire test invocation to be resubmitted, following unrelated failed checks for Git status and the `file` utility.

limitations.quote: When one pointer already uses the right clock and reset, use it as a template for the other.
limitations.note: The agent read the directly relevant advice to mirror the existing pointer block, but it did not inform the fix: the agent rewrote both pointer updates instead.
